audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization block and the late-game breakdown both tell the player to buy Executioner's Calling early because 'his healing fights your pattern'. Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit.
audit.why: Riot's texts: Runic Blade (charges), Broken Wings (strikes/knockback), Ki Burst (stun), Valor (step + blocks incoming damage), Blade of the Exile (AD, range, Wind Slash). No heal, no lifesteal effect. Anti-heal is a wasted item slot in this lane, and it is being recommended as core.
audit.corrected: Skip anti-heal. What actually blunts your burst is Valor's shield, so the gold goes into damage and the play is to force E out first.

audit.whatIsWrong: Valor is described only as a dash ('her E-dash', 'she E-dashes out'). Its shield is never mentioned once.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.' missingInteractions flags it: the shield absorbs your burst window. On a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown it is up for most of your engages, so committing a full combo into a fresh Valor wastes it.
audit.corrected: Valor is a shield as well as a dash — force it out before you dump the combo.

audit.why: Defiant Dance is the right call here and was kept: Riven's damage is entirely physical, so W's physical reduction applies to the whole Q3-into-Ki-Burst burst. Same as the Pantheon and Renekton entries, unlike Mordekaiser and Olaf.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 3 read Skill while whys[3] says she peaks there and dashes out before you can chain a reset; row 4 read Skill while whys[4] describes your R trapping a dash-based champion; row 6 read Riven while whys[6] says 'You reclaim it at 2 items'.
audit.why: The packet chart is (Skill, Riven, Riven, Riven, Irelia, Riven, Skill). Rows 3 and 4 are clear-cut. Row 6 is the awkward one: the chart says Skill, the prose said Irelia, the stored side said Riven — three different answers. At a 48.22% win rate, Skill is the defensible reading, so I moved the side to Skill and softened whys[6] and spikes[3].text to match rather than leaving prose and side disagreeing again.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs; whys[6] and spikes[3].text reworded from 'you reclaim' to 'it evens'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Irelia's passive credited with shredding Riven's 'thin bruiser resists' in whys[6], spikes[3].text, late and wants.you[2].
audit.why: Ionian Fervor is stacking Attack Speed plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks — no shred. Riven's spikes themselves (Ki Burst at 11s, her Hydra/Eclipse first item, Blade of the Exile at 120/90/60s) are stated correctly.
audit.corrected: Replaced with max Ionian Fervor attack speed and on-hit damage.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Blade of the Ruined King  (%HP + the duel spike), then Wit's End / Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Blade of the Ruined King (%HP + the duel spike), then Wit's End / Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Skip anti-heal — nothing in her kit heals; Valor's shield is what eats your burst.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill — build your teamfight around that. Riven carry threat: 8/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Vanguard’s Edge walls off her disengage and marks the kill — build your teamfight around that. Riven carry threat: 8/10 — she has no healing, so skip anti-heal and shift to picks if she gets ahead.

edits.before: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Riven when his answer is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.
edits.after: Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1 and it's her only hard CC — everything after it is a dash you can wall off.
Force out Valor before you commit

edits.before: Riven wastes Ki Burst (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Valor is a shield as well as a dash, 10s at rank 1, and it eats your burst.

edits.before: That is Riven's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Her whole combo is built on landing it first — hold your dash until it is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile adds AD, range and one free ranged Wind Slash.

edits.before: You reclaim it at 2 items: max Bladesurge stacks shred her thin resists and Q-resets keep you glued to her as her burst falls off.
edits.after: It evens at 2 items: max Ionian Fervor and Q-resets keep you glued to her, but a clean combo through Valor still kills you outright.

edits.before: You reclaim the duel: at max Bladesurge stacks your on-hit shreds her thin bruiser resists, and Q-resets off the wave keep you glued to her after her combo whiffs and her burst falls off.
edits.after: The duel evens out: at max Ionian Fervor stacks your on-hit damage lands fast, and Q-resets off the wave keep you glued to her after her combo whiffs and her burst falls off.

edits.before: Her first-item spike (Hydra or Eclipse) is terrifying and can one-combo you, so play around your E and W cooldowns until you hit 2 items yourself. From there the lane swings back: Riven runs thin bruiser resists for your max-stack passive to shred, and her burst-and-reset pattern falls off against a sustained fighter, while your Q-resets off any wave keep you stuck to her the moment her combo whiffs. Stacked on-hit DPS beats her burst window in a drawn-out fight — bait the combo, survive it with W, then run her down once her dashes are on cooldown.
edits.after: Her first-item spike (Hydra or Eclipse) is terrifying and can one-combo you, so play around your E and W cooldowns until you hit 2 items yourself. From there it evens: her burst-and-reset pattern falls off against a sustained fighter, while your Q-resets off any wave keep you stuck to her the moment her combo whiffs. Remember Valor (E) is a shield as well as a dash, 10s at rank 1 — force it out before you dump anything. Bait the combo, survive it with W, then run her down once her dashes are on cooldown.

edits.before: Reach 6 and trap her with R, or hit 2 items where your stacked on-hit shred and Q-reset sustain grind her down
edits.after: Reach 6 and trap her with R, or hit 2 items where max Ionian Fervor stacks and Q-reset sustain grind her down

notes: The itemization block told the player to rush Executioner's Calling because 'his healing fights your pattern' — Riven has no healing in her kit at all, so that is a wasted item slot recommended as core, and the same claim was repeated in breakdown.late. Both corrected. Valor's shield was never mentioned despite being flagged in missingInteractions and being the reason burst combos fail here. QUESTION FOR THE USER is recorded separately on the 2+ items row: the packet chart said Skill, the stored side said Riven, and the whys text said Irelia — three different answers. I took the packet's Skill and softened the prose to match, but if the intended reading is that Irelia genuinely reclaims the duel at two items, row 6 should be Irelia in both layers instead.
